newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai state agency revenue to cover deficit-govt.
newsitem.headline: Thai state agency revenue to cover deficit-govt.

text.p: Thai deputy Finance Minister Chaturong Chaisaeng said on Monday the government will seek more contributions from state enterprises to cover any revenue shortfall for fiscal 1996/97 (September-October).

"We decided not to raise any tax to cover the government's revenue shortfall of about 16 billion baht ($640 million)," he told reporters. "We will ask all state enterprises to contribute more revenue (to cover the deficit). I think this should be enough," he said.

The country's sharply slowing economy has substantially reduced tax revenues this year, and the Bank of Thailand predicted last month that the government's operating budget would end the current fiscal year with a 23.1 billion baht deficit, its first in ten years.
The administration has insisted it will maintain a deficit-free budget in this fiscal year.
